lead: Heat mat for warming the bottom of a terrarium. Heats the substrate evenly, ideal for species that need heat from below.

description.html: A heat mat (heating film) is an efficient way to warm the bottom of a terrarium. It is placed under the terrarium and heats the substrate evenly, which is especially important for species that need heat from below - so-called "belly heat". Leopard geckos, for example, use heat from the ground to digest their food, so this type of heating is essential for them. The heat mat should cover about one third of the terrarium floor so the animal can move to the cooler side when needed. We recommend using it together with a thermostat that keeps the temperature stable and prevents overheating. It is available in several sizes, so you can choose the right one for your terrarium.
